
FFmpeg (Windows packages only)
------------------------------
  This package bundles ffmpeg.exe. The game's movies are Sofdec (MPEG) video
  inside movie.afs, and the FMV path decodes them by running ffmpeg. On Linux
  ffmpeg comes from the distribution; Windows has none, so it ships here.
  Without it the movies are a black screen with the audio still playing.

  Build     BtbN FFmpeg-Builds, ffmpeg-n9.0-latest-win64-lgpl-9.0 (static)
  Licence   LGPL-3.0-or-later       (built --enable-version3)
  Modified  no -- shipped exactly as published, byte for byte

  The exact build is whichever that rolling asset held when this package was
  made; `ffmpeg.exe -version` in this folder prints it, and that string is what
  identifies the source revision below.

  LGPL requires that you can get the source for this component and relink it.
  Both halves are public and unmodified:

    FFmpeg source, tag n9.0.1   https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg
    the build recipe used       https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds

  This build deliberately excludes the GPL-only encoders (no libx264, libx265,
  libxvid, libdavs2, libxavs2), which is why it is LGPL rather than GPL and why
  it imposes no licence obligation on the rest of this package. Do not swap in
  a "-gpl" ffmpeg build without revisiting that: it would make the combined
  distribution GPL-3.0, which conflicts with the GPL-2.0 runtime.

  ffmpeg is not started with any input this project does not construct itself:
  the only invocation is a read of the player's own movie.afs.
